entries.reason: Single Responsibility — Goal, scope, and principles consistently target one concern: reqId source selection for diff-based gate.; Task Single Responsibility — Both tasks are focused on the same concern (source-selection logic and its test coverage) without unrelated bundled work.; Unambiguous Requirements — R7 includes subjective wording (e.g., 'make direct coverage practical'), which is not fully verifiable.; Complete Context — Most requirements are specific, but R7 leaves room for interpretation, so independent reviewers may disagree.; REQ Diff-Verifiability — Requirements are largely decidable from code diff plus test outcomes (logic, fallback behavior, and coverage expectations).; No Hardcoded Secrets — No secrets, credentials, or hardcoded sensitive values are introduced in this spec content.; No Silent Error Swallowing — No instruction in the spec suggests swallowing errors; article is not implicated by the proposed changes.; Prioritize Requirements — There are more than three requirements and each includes a priority (must/should).; Record Unresolved Points as Open Questions — Open questions are explicitly represented (empty) and decisions are tied to stated evidence/scope.; Include 'Why This Approach' Rationale — Rationale is present via decisions with evidence and alternatives considered/rejected.; Spec Test Coverage — Spec does not require tests under specs/<specid>/tests/ with per-file '// spec: R<N> ...' headers as mandated.; Backward-Compatible CLI Interface — Spec explicitly states no CLI command/option meaning changes, so migration plan is not required.; Exit Code Contract — No CLI command is added/modified; constraints explicitly preserve existing exit-code contracts.; Validate User Input at Entry Point — No new or modified user-facing CLI arguments are introduced in this change scope.
